description: The Canvas64 price model for one step of any cell: its price, what its owner gets when bought out, their royalty on every later sale, and optionally how much that royalty has paid once the cell reaches a later step. Prices rise 1.65x per step from $30, with no cap.

step.description: The purchase number; 1 is a claim of a free cell.

until.description: Optional: a later step, to sum the royalty earned up to it.

name: quote
title: Price a step
